description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sippikulama, No. 90 Sinibopura, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map . No.830111
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details, and title classifications. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and cadastral mapping - all falling under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
